lines.amount: 750 ml in the pot; ~105 g absorbed (13 % of ~790 g batter)
lines.reference: Oil, sunflower, linoleic (approx. 65%) — USDA FDC 171025: 884 kcal / 100 g

notes: Six portions of the batch (about 8 bites each). Assumptions that move the number: the batter is ~790 g and absorbs ~13 % of its weight in oil (~105 g, ~930 kcal), in the middle of the 10-15 % range for battered fritters. Each 5 % of absorption moves a portion by ~60 kcal. Only the absorbed oil is counted, not the 750 ml in the pot. Compared against: Spinneys fried green chilli bites at 397 kcal a serving (4 servings, ~265 at six), and pepperscale daltjies at ~74 kcal a fritter. Ours, at 330, is a little higher than Spinneys because our batch has more flour per portion.
